items.name: Burger with mayo, ketchup and mustard; tater tots; partially eaten mayo/mustard dip
items.portion: 1 burger and all tots; only consumed portion of dip counted
items.source: Native inspection of original food photo img_539ae123bb8e.jpeg and leftovers photo img_e2e508f99148.jpeg; user confirmed all food eaten except some dip. USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy ingredient searches retrieved November 9, 2026; public-domain nutrient proxies, not exact product labels. No external photo estimator result used.
items.note: Logged November 9, 2026 after verifying America/New_York date. Credible high-side ingredient estimate, not measured nutrition. Original photo shows one thick beef patty on an open bun, generous mayonnaise/ketchup/mustard, a small cluster of tots partly cropped at right, and a large separate mound of mayo/mustard dip. Leftovers photo shows burger/tots gone and substantial dip still present. Comparing photos suggests only a minority of dip was eaten; different angle/spreading prevents reliable volume subtraction. Provisionally count about 1.5 tablespoons mixed dip (22.5 g: 15 g mayo + 7.5 g mustard), plausibly about 1-2 tablespoons; this is a modeling assumption, NOT an exact tablespoon measurement from photos. Do not count all served dip. No cheese, drinks, extra sides or separate cooking oil assumed. Main uncertainty is patty weight, bun/condiment amounts, cropped tot count/preparation, and dip consumption/ratio. Approximate plausible meal range 800-1200 kcal is a judgment range, not a statistical confidence interval. Total carbohydrates retained.
